n1.speaker: npc_gatekeeper
n1.text: The archivist sent you. Good. Listen. The raiders are Reclaimers: Furnace Guild muscle, not my department.

n2.speaker: npc_gatekeeper
n2.text: Someone up here sells them souls in violet ink. Your honest stamps send those souls to Heaven, so the Guild comes to collect by claw.

n3.speaker: npc_gatekeeper
n3.text: I recover debts, Adjudicator. Real ones. This is theft with paperwork. When the Captain comes, I'll be standing next to you.
